family_definitions.Aerial: How many aerial duels the player wins per 90: more duels contested and more won both raise it; not the share won.
family_definitions.Carrying: How often the player carries the ball forward and into the box, per 90: volume, not dribbling success.
family_definitions.Creation: How many open-play passes per 90 lead to a shot: volume of chances made, not their quality.
family_definitions.Goal threat: How many non-penalty shots the player takes and puts on target per 90: volume, not finishing.
family_definitions.Progression: How often the player completes passes forward, into the final third and into the box, per 90: counts of completed passes, not the share completed.

completion_vs_expected.label: Completion vs expected
completion_vs_expected.definition: Open-play pass completion minus the completion expected for the player's mix of short (under 15 yards), medium (15 to 30) and long (30 and over) passes, at the completion rates of ranked players in the same league and position, in percentage points. Lengths are in StatsBomb pitch units (about yards). Restarts, and passes with an unknown outcome or kicked out for an injury, are left out.

notes.short: associated with team possession
notes.full: completion vs expected still rises with the team's share of the ball for this position (checked before launch), so no Passing score is shown
